# @arki/ai

> Local-first AI for TypeScript apps: Ollama by default, cloud providers by explicit setting, embeddings, a vector index with erasure, a tool-loop runtime and returned (not thrown) rate-limit and budget failures.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/ai`: Comprehensive AI, RAG, and Vector Search Library Provides reusable AI infrastructure for all Arki projects. `AIError`, `AnthropicService`, `BUDGET_PERIODS`, `BUDGET_PERIOD_DURATIONS`, `BudgetExceeded`, `BudgetManager`, `CIRCUIT_STATES`, `CircuitBreakerError`, `ConfigurationError`, `ContentAnalysisSchema`, `CostCircuitBreaker`, `CostEstimator`; and 196 more.
- react/* (3 paths): React components and hooks for AI functionality. `@arki/ai/react`, `@arki/ai/react/index`, `@arki/ai/react/md`.
- drizzle/* (2 paths): Erasure outbox for a vector index, on Drizzle + Postgres (the SQLite twin is @arki/ai/drizzle/sqlite). `@arki/ai/drizzle`, `@arki/ai/drizzle/sqlite`.
- ai-service/* (2 paths): `@arki/ai/ai-service/types`, `@arki/ai/ai-service/structured-generation`.
- capabilities/* (5 paths): `@arki/ai/capabilities/ask`, `@arki/ai/capabilities/episode-analysis`, `@arki/ai/capabilities/pips`, `@arki/ai/capabilities/queue`, `@arki/ai/capabilities/podhop`.
- one path each: `@arki/ai/cost`, `@arki/ai/safety`, `@arki/ai/dot`, `@arki/ai/testing`, `@arki/ai/env`, `@arki/ai/sdk`, `@arki/ai/anthropic`, `@arki/ai/google`, `@arki/ai/groq`, `@arki/ai/mistral`, `@arki/ai/openai`, `@arki/ai/mastra`, `@arki/ai/transcription`, `@arki/ai/validation`, `@arki/ai/zod`, `@arki/ai/runtime/index`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- With `LLM_PROVIDER` unset the provider is Ollama. A cloud key never overrides an Ollama signal.
- `RateLimited` and `BudgetExceeded` are returned, not thrown. Check before you iterate a stream.
- This package stores and ranks vectors. It does not make them: use `@arki/embeddings`.
- A tool result is checked against its `output` schema. A tool returns a failure for an expected outcome.
- The server entries are not browser-safe.
